newsitem.title: HONDURAS: North and Central America port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: North and Central America port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

HONDURAS, May 26 - Puerto Cortes - vessels berthed, 4 discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging paper rolls, 1 discharging general. Vessels awaiting berth, 5 to discharge/load containers, 1 to discharge explosives. Vessels due, 5 to discharge bananas, 5 to load/discharge containers, 1 to load sugar, 1 to discharging fertiliser.
MEXICO, May 27 - Tampico - vessels in port 2 steel coils, 3 minerals, 1 pipes, 2 general cargo. Port working normally.
Altamira - vessels in port 2 containers, 1 general cargo, 1 steel sheets. Working normally.
Veracruz - vessels in port 2 general cargo, 4 grain, 3 pipes, 2 sugar, 1 scrap, 2 container vessels. Working normally.
Manzanillo - vessels in port 2 containers, 2 general cargo, 1 clinker, 1 beans, 1 urea, 1 repairs. Working normally.
Coatzacoalcos - vessels in port 7 chemicals, 10 oil tankers. 1 under repairs. Working normally.

PANAMA, May 27, Panama canal - traffic backlog is down to normal levels, and any delays are solely due to daily ship arrival numbers. The transit booking system will be at condition 1 (normal operation) from 0001 hours 28/5.

The following simultaneous Miraflores and Gatun locks lane outages are scheduled 7/7 to 19/7, 11/8 to 21/8. During the above periods, canal authorities are projecting daily transits of 28-30 vessels. Delays may build up to 5-6 days depending on ship daily arrival numbers. Earliest booking advice required to include name of cargo and draft.
